newsitem.title: USA: Northwest Airlines extends fare sale.
newsitem.headline: Northwest Airlines extends fare sale.

text.p: Northwest Airlines Corp on Monday said it would extend the deadline for its summer fare promotion until March 6 in response to strong consumer demand.
The promotion, which offers savings of as much as 50 percent off certain fares for travel through September 3, originally required tickets to be bought by March 3.
The carrier said a 14-day advance purchase is required and other restrictions apply.
Northwest shares were unchanged at 35-3/8 in early afternoon trading.
